summary: Read a list of integers and a window width k. The window first covers the leftmost k integers, then shifts one step to the right until the right end of the window reaches the end of the list. The window always contains exactly k integers. At every stop, find the largest integer inside the window, and write those largest integers from left to right. The width k is at least 1 and is never greater than the length of the list.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
